entries.46386d4d022e9f92: It is a machinery manufacturer headquartered in Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture. Together with one consolidated subsidiary (Foreco Co., Ltd.), it carries on three businesses: the Engineering Business, the Chemical Equipment Business, and the Energy and Environment Business. As of March 31, 2026, it had 442 employees, and its shares are listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.4c554084cd148cc0: This business designs, fabricates, processes and sells nuclear fuel transport containers and storage devices, nuclear fuel enrichment-related equipment, radioactive waste treatment equipment, radiation shielding facilities and experimental facilities, and it installs these products and carries out the related incidental work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,398 million. Its consolidated subsidiary Foreco Co., Ltd. manufactures and carries out construction work for, and sells, products in this business.
entries.ab30be34e0f4632f: A machinery manufacturer headquartered in Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture, handling everything from the design, manufacture, and installation of chemical machinery and equipment to plant maintenance and nuclear-related equipment.
entries.c156901f3b47a9d7: Plant-owning companies such as chemical manufacturers
entries.c9d31e48862c4d67: Chemical manufacturers and others that own plant equipment
entries.d15db176167dd854: This business carries out related construction work for plant equipment and machinery (fabrication, removal of existing equipment, installation, piping, painting, insulation, and trial operation and adjustment), and manages and contracts out maintenance work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,377 million, the largest of the three businesses. Its bases are the Tokai, East Chugoku and Shikoku business offices.
entries.d50b3d87caf85b31: This business designs, fabricates, processes and sells evaporators, distillation equipment, crystallizers, cleaning equipment, agitators, pressure vessel tanks and various piping work, and it installs these products and carries out the related incidental work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,196 million. It is characterized by an approach in which it carries out the work consistently from design through to trial operation.
